app_fee.value: Central research guidance outlines tuition fees and postgraduate funding without stating a general application fee for research degree programmes.

fee_waiver.value: Central guidance does not publish fee waiver procedures as no general PGR application fee is stated.

gre_general.value: GRE General test is not required or requested centrally for postgraduate research admission at Liverpool.

toefl_min.value: Liverpool accepts TOEFL iBT (excluding Home Edition) as an approved alternative test alongside course-specific requirements.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT (excluding TOEFL Home Edition which is not accepted)

ielts_min.value: Most postgraduate research courses require IELTS 6.5 overall with no component less than 5.5 (or 6.0 in some disciplines).
